name: Exp_Leading
summary: This EA trades based on crossover signals from the custom 'Leading' indicator, which uses two EMA-like smoothing lines with configurable alpha coefficients. It opens buy positions when Ma1 crosses above Ma2 and sell positions when Ma1 crosses below Ma2, with optional close-on-reverse-signal functionality and fixed stop loss/take profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义'Leading'指标的均线交叉信号进行交易，该指标使用两个可配置alpha系数的类EMA平滑线。当Ma1上穿Ma2时开多仓，下穿时开空仓，支持反向信号平仓及固定止损止盈。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念是基于Leading指标的两条平滑线交叉来判断趋势方向，属于典型的趋势跟踪策略。入场条件为：当Ma1[1]>Ma2[1]且Ma1[0]<Ma2[0]时，检测到金叉信号，开启买入；当Ma1[1]<Ma2[1]且Ma1[0]>Ma2[0]时，检测到死叉信号，开启卖出。出场条件包括固定止损（1000点）和固定止盈（2000点），以及反向交叉信号触发的平仓功能。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，支持手数模式和保证金比例模式两种资金管理方式。资金管理采用固定的止损止盈比例（1:2），风险回报比合理。EA使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复开仓，同时通过SignalBar参数允许选择信号来源K线的位置。
strategy_analysis_en: The EA's strategy concept is based on the crossover of two smoothed lines from the Leading indicator to determine trend direction, making it a classic trend-following system. Entry conditions: when Ma1[1]>Ma2[1] and Ma1[0]<Ma2[0], a golden cross is detected and a buy position is opened; when Ma1[1]<Ma2[1] and Ma1[0]>Ma2[0], a death cross is detected and a sell position is opened. Exit conditions include a fixed stop loss of 1000 points, a fixed take profit of 2000 points, and optional closing on reverse crossover signals. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, supporting both lot-based mode and margin-based percentage mode for money management. The risk-reward ratio is set at 1:2 (stop loss 1000 vs take profit 2000), which is reasonable. The EA uses an IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are calculated only once per bar, preventing duplicate entries, and the SignalBar parameter allows selecting which bar's data to use for signal generation.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理参数，控制仓位大小
parameters.description_en: Money management parameter controlling lot size or ratio

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 手数计算模式（固定手数或保证金比例）
parameters.description_en: Lot calculation mode (Free Margin/Balance/Free Margin with Floating Loss/Balance with Floating Loss/Fixed Lot)

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许反向信号平多仓
parameters.description_en: Allow closing buy positions on signal

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许反向信号平空仓
parameters.description_en: Allow closing sell positions on signal

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description_en: Signal bar index (0=current bar, 1=last completed bar)

parameters.name: Alpha1
parameters.description_en: Alpha coefficient for the first smoothing line

parameters.name: Alpha2
parameters.description_en: Alpha coefficient for the second smoothing line

pros: 策略逻辑清晰，双线交叉信号直观易懂
风险回报比为1:2，止盈大于止损，长期正期望
支持独立的买入/卖出开关和反向平仓开关，灵活性高
使用IsNewBar机制防止同一K线重复开仓
Alpha系数可调，允许优化指标灵敏度
pros_en: Clear and intuitive strategy logic based on dual-line crossover signals
Risk-reward ratio of 1:2 with take profit larger than stop loss, providing positive expectancy
Independent toggle switches for buy/sell opening and closing offer high flexibility
IsNewBar mechanism prevents duplicate entries on the same bar
Adjustable alpha coefficients allow optimization of indicator sensitivity
cons: 依赖自定义Leading指标，指标源码不在此文件中，增加了理解和维护难度
固定止损止盈不适应市场波动性变化，在低波动期止损过大，高波动期止盈过小
缺少移动止损（追踪止损）功能，可能在大幅盈利后回撤过多
未考虑点差和交易成本对短线信号的影响
默认止损1000点过大，在H4周期可能导致较大单笔亏损
cons_en: Depends on a custom Leading indicator whose source code is not included, increasing difficulty of understanding and maintenance
Fixed stop loss and take profit do not adapt to market volatility changes — SL may be too large in low volatility and TP too small in high volatility
Lacks trailing stop functionality, which may result in significant profit givebacks after large favorable moves
Does not account for spread and transaction costs impact on signals
Default stop loss of 1000 points is quite large, potentially leading to significant per-trade losses on H4 timeframe
improvements: 引入ATR动态止损止盈，根据市场波动性自适应调整止损止盈距离
添加移动止损功能，在盈利达到一定程度后锁定部分利润
improvements_en: Introduce ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit to adapt SL/TP distances based on market volatility
Add trailing stop functionality to lock in partial profits after reaching a certain profit threshold

risk_points: 固定止损1000点在部分品种上可能导致单笔亏损较大
缺少对持仓数量的检查，可能在趋势反复时频繁开平仓
依赖外部自定义指标，若指标文件缺失则EA无法运行
risk_points_en: Fixed 1000-point stop loss may result in large per-trade losses on some instruments
Lacks position count checks, potentially leading to frequent open/close cycles in choppy markets
Depends on an external custom indicator; if the indicator file is missing, the EA fails to initialize

It opens buy positions when Ma1 crosses above Ma2 and sell positions when Ma1 crosses below Ma2, with optional close-on-reverse-signal functionality and fixed stop loss/take profit levels.
